summary: Tested the no-card free-trial model changes end-to-end. Backend: 3/3 new tests PASS (/app/backend/tests/test_no_card_trial.py) — register creates trial user with trial_days_left=14 (no payment), /auth/me returns trial tier+days_left and flips to 'expired' when trial_end is past, and payments.py no longer contains trial_period_days anywhere. Frontend: Hero CTA routes to /auth?trial=true with NO localStorage.inflow_pending_checkout; pricing card CTA (Essential) routes to /auth with NO pending checkout; /choose-plan shows new copy 'Pick the plan that fits your team. Billing starts today — cancel anytime.' (old 14-day copy gone); FAQ shows 'Sign up with just your email — no credit card required.'; new-user register lands on /dashboard (not /choose-plan); TrialNotification popup renders for trial tier at 1-day milestone ('Your trial expires tomorrow', View Plans & Upgrade + Remind me later) and for 'expired' tier shows 'Your free trial has expired' with 'Upgrade Now' + 'Return to homepage' and NO close button (non-dismissible).

payments.py create_subscription_checkout: no trial_period_days in session_params. Static source-scan assertion added to test to guard against regression.
Landing.js: handleStartTrial correctly routes unauthenticated users to /auth?trial=true and authenticated users to /dashboard.
PricingSection.js handlePlanClick: calls handleGetStarted (which routes to /auth) when unauth — no longer sets inflow_pending_checkout. Clean.
TrialNotification.js: for expired tier the dialog hides its close button (onOpenChange ignored) and shows Upgrade Now + Return to homepage. Verified in DOM.
